_about: What an implementing agent must know before it builds, deploys or tests end to end: the questions it must be able to answer (required) and may also read (optional). `oto query brief <task> NAME=<entity>` is READY or BLOCKED by name.

implement-component.description: An agent is about to write a component's code: it must know what to build it with, at which versions, and every choice about the component must be settled.

deploy-component.description: An agent is about to deploy a component: where it runs, on what, with which secrets from where, by which pipeline, every choice about it settled.

test-end-to-end.description: An agent is about to test the product end to end in an environment: the environment fully described, every component in it deployable, every secret placed, every choice about it settled.
